units: <cite ref="Menachot 11a:6">Men. 11ᵃ</cite> <he>זו א׳</he> with this (the fourth from the little finger) the measure of ‘a finger’ is taken; <cite ref="Ketubot 5b:1">Keth. 5ᵇ</cite>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 4:5:13">Y. Taan. IV, 68ᵈ</cite> bot.; <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 2:4">Lam. R. to II, 2</cite> (<he>מטיפי</he>) <he>מקוטעי א׳</he> who had their finger cut off (in evidence of devotion to the cause).
Yoma I, 7 א׳ צרדה; Tosef. ib. I, 9 explained א׳ גדולה middle finger; cmp. Tanḥ. Bo, end, expl. אמצעית.—

<cite ref="Ketubot 71a:9">Keth. 71ᵃ</cite> <he>הוא נותן א׳ וכ׳</he> he (the husband) puts his finger between her teeth (and must expect to be bitten), i.e. has to take the consequences of not interfering with her vow in due time.

senses.gloss: any projecting limb resembling the shape of a finger.
units: Ḥull. 61ᵃ א׳ יתירה the projecting toe on a bird’s claw.
Tam. IV, 3 (31ᵃ) א׳ הכבד the lobe of the liver.—Fig. (like יד) share, part.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 4:3:5">Y. Pes. IV, 31ᵃ</cite> top; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 1:6:5">Y. Ab. Zar. I, 40ᵃ</cite> top, v. <cite ref="A02056"><he>אֶמְצַע</he></cite>.—Pl. <he>אֶצְבָּעוֹת</he>.
Ḥag. 15ᵃ; a. fr. (mostly in the sense of finger’s length).—
Pes. 112ᵇ; Nidd. 66ᵃ euphem. for membra virilia.—Dual אֶצְבְּעַיִּם, אֶצְבְּעַיִּים, Cant. R. to VIII, 11 גידם א׳ one whose (index) fingers were lopped (stump-like).
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 8:11">Ib.</cite> that whole trade of mine <he>אינה נקנית אלא בא׳</he> cannot be acquired except by learning how to use the index-fingers.—
